scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:wait --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "$p5000 = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p5000){Stop-Process -Id $p5000 -Force}; $p3000 = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p3000){Stop-Process -Id $p3000 -Force}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1"
scripts.restart: npm run kill-ports && npm run dev
